headline: DPSC Limited: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process — 2nd CoC Meeting of India Power Corporation Limited
sum: DPSC Limited has informed NSE of the 2nd Committee of Creditors meeting under a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) concerning India Power Corporation Limited (IPCL), signalling progression through the statutory creditor approval framework under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code.
detail: DPSC Limited notified the NSE of prior intimation of the 2nd (Second) Committee of Creditors meeting relating to the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process of India Power Corporation Limited (IPCL). This filing falls under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (LODR) 2015, which mandates listed entities to disclose material updates regarding insolvency proceedings affecting group entities or related parties. The 2nd CoC meeting represents a substantive stage in the CIRP framework, typically dealing with approval or modification of the resolution plan and creditor voting thresholds.
